title: Date Pilaf Delight
description: A sweet and savory pilaf dish featuring caramelized dates and a hint of buttery flavor.
instructions: 1. Heat butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add pilaf and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
3. Add dates to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to caramelize, about 5-7 minutes.
4. Fluff pilaf with a fork to separate grains.
5. Serve pilaf mixture hot, topped with velvety if desired.
